mapper.select: SELECT la.loan_account_id, la.loan_type, la.current_balance, la.interest_rate, la.rate_type, la.repayment_type, la.maturity_at, la.loan_status, la.prepayment_fee_rate, la.prepayment_fee_end_date FROM loan_account la JOIN mydata_connection mc ON mc.connection_id = la.connection_id WHERE mc.user_id = #{userId} AND la.loan_status = '정상'
